title: Apex Motorsports Parts - Sales
description: Explore December 2025 sales of Apex Motorsports Parts (a fictional performance-parts seller): net revenue, margin and orders by day, week, region, dealer tier, dealer, state and part category.
_note: Reference definition for the Genie notebooks (03b/04/11). Table names assume the default CONFIG (catalog dbx_workshop_dev, source schema shared); remap them as in notebook 11 for another environment.
sql_instructions:
Business context: Apex Motorsports Parts sells performance parts through about 500 dealers. All sales data covers December 2025.
Tables: lab_gold_daily_dealer_sales_fact (one row per order_date x dealer), lab_gold_category_region_fact (one row per region x part category, no dates or dealers), lab_silver_dealers_dim (one row per dealer; the only place with the dealer's two-letter state code), lab_silver_parts_dim (one row per part; catalog data, no sales).
Join: lab_gold_daily_dealer_sales_fact.dealer_id = lab_silver_dealers_dim.dealer_id (many-to-one).
Margin % = 100 * SUM(margin) / SUM(net_revenue). Never average margin_pct or daily percentages.
Average revenue per order = SUM(net_revenue) / SUM(orders).
Sales / revenue mean net_revenue. Orders means the orders column (order lines).
Weeks start on Monday: CAST(DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', order_date) AS DATE).
Map state names to two-letter codes (Texas = 'TX'). Use exact matches for region, dealer_tier, category and state.
Round money and percentages to 2 decimals; cast counts with CAST(... AS BIGINT).
sample_questions: What was the total net revenue in December 2025?
What was the margin % by dealer tier?
Which part category has the highest margin %?

curated_questions.question: What was the total net revenue in December 2025?
How many dealers had at least one order?
curated_questions.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT dealer_id) AS BIGINT) AS dealers FROM dbx_workshop_dev.shared.lab_gold_daily_dealer_sales_fact

curated_questions.question: What was the margin % by dealer tier?
curated_questions.sql: SELECT dealer_tier, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(margin) / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue), 0), 2) AS margin_pct FROM dbx_workshop_dev.shared.lab_gold_daily_dealer_sales_fact GROUP BY dealer_tier ORDER BY margin_pct DESC

curated_questions.question: What was the margin % by region?
curated_questions.sql: SELECT region, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(margin) / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue), 0), 2) AS margin_pct FROM dbx_workshop_dev.shared.lab_gold_daily_dealer_sales_fact GROUP BY region ORDER BY margin_pct DESC

curated_questions.question: What was the net revenue of dealers in Ohio?
curated_questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue FROM dbx_workshop_dev.shared.lab_gold_daily_dealer_sales_fact s JOIN dbx_workshop_dev.shared.lab_silver_dealers_dim d ON s.dealer_id = d.dealer_id WHERE d.state = 'OH'

curated_questions.question: Net revenue by dealer state
curated_questions.sql: SELECT d.state, ROUND(SUM(s.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue FROM dbx_workshop_dev.shared.lab_gold_daily_dealer_sales_fact s JOIN dbx_workshop_dev.shared.lab_silver_dealers_dim d ON s.dealer_id = d.dealer_id GROUP BY d.state ORDER BY net_revenue DESC

curated_questions.question: Top 5 dealers by net revenue in the Northeast region
curated_questions.sql: SELECT dealer_name, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue FROM dbx_workshop_dev.shared.lab_gold_daily_dealer_sales_fact WHERE region = 'Northeast' GROUP BY dealer_name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

curated_questions.question: What was the average revenue per order by region?
curated_questions.sql: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(orders), 0), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_order FROM dbx_workshop_dev.shared.lab_gold_daily_dealer_sales_fact GROUP BY region ORDER BY avg_revenue_per_order DESC

curated_questions.question: Weekly net revenue by region
curated_questions.sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', order_date) AS DATE) AS order_week, region, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue FROM dbx_workshop_dev.shared.lab_gold_daily_dealer_sales_fact GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY order_week, region

curated_questions.question: Daily net revenue on weekends vs weekdays
curated_questions.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(order_date) IN (1, 7) THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_date), 2) AS avg_daily_net_revenue FROM dbx_workshop_dev.shared.lab_gold_daily_dealer_sales_fact GROUP BY 1

curated_questions.question: What is the margin % for each part category across all regions?
curated_questions.sql: SELECT category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(margin) / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue), 0), 2) AS margin_pct FROM dbx_workshop_dev.shared.lab_gold_category_region_fact GROUP BY category ORDER BY margin_pct DESC

curated_questions.question: Net revenue by part category in the West region
curated_questions.sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue FROM dbx_workshop_dev.shared.lab_gold_category_region_fact WHERE region = 'West' GROUP BY category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC

curated_questions.question: How many parts are in each category, and what is their average list price?
curated_questions.sql: SELECT category, CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS parts, ROUND(AVG(list_price), 2) AS avg_list_price FROM dbx_workshop_dev.shared.lab_silver_parts_dim GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
